events.text: Li graduated from National Central University (Nanjing University).
events.subject: self
events.quote: He graduated from National Central University ( Nanjing University ) in 1930

events.text: Li studied physics at Cambridge University.
events.subject: self
events.quote: studied physics at Cambridge University in 1934

events.text: Li fled from the Chinese Communist Party to Taiwan with the Nationalist Party.
events.subject: self
events.quote: he fled from the Chinese Communist Party to Taiwan in July 1948 with the Nationalist Party

events.text: Li became the president of the Taiwan Shipbuilding Corporation.
events.subject: self
events.quote: He became the president of the Taiwan Shipbuilding Corporation in 1951

events.text: Li was appointed as a member of the Industrial Development Commission.
events.subject: self
events.quote: was appointed as a member of the Industrial Development Commission responsible for the planning and economic development of Taiwan in 1953

events.text: Li became the head of the Industrial Development and Investment Center.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1959 he became the head of the Industrial Development and Investment Center
